columns.name: ContentObjectId
columns.description: Unique identifier of the content

columns.name: OrgUnitId
columns.description: Unique org unit identifier

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Content title

columns.name: ContentObjectType
columns.description: Content object type

columns.name: CompletionType
columns.description: Content completion type

columns.name: ParentContentObjectId
columns.description: Parent content object identifier

columns.name: Location
columns.description: Location of the content asset. Field can be null.

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: Content availability start date (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: EndDate
columns.description: Content availability end date (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: DueDate
columns.description: Content availability due date (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: ObjectId1
columns.description: Quick link Object ID for the associated tool. Maps to DropboxId, QuizId, ChecklistId, SurveyId, ChatId, Self-AssessmentId. For Discussions, this field is used if a Forum is quicklinked. Field can be null.

columns.name: ObjectId2
columns.description: Quick link Object ID, only used for the Discussion tool if a Topic is quicklinked. Field can be null.

columns.name: ObjectId3
columns.description: Quick link Object ID, only used for the Discussion tool if a Thread is quicklinked. Field can be null.

columns.name: LastModified
columns.description: Date the content was last modified (UTC).

columns.name: IsDeleted
columns.description: Content is deleted

columns.name: SortOrder
columns.description: Display sort order used for the content objects

columns.name: Depth
columns.description: Indicates the number of nested hierarchical levels in the discussion post.

columns.name: ToolId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the tool. Field can be null.

columns.name: IsHidden
columns.description: Content object has not been published yet

columns.name: ResultId
columns.description: Release Condition unique result identifier. Field can be null.

columns.name: DeletedDate
columns.description: Date when the content object was deleted (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.description: User who created the content object. Field can be null.

columns.name: LastModifiedBy
columns.description: User who last modified the content object. Field can be null.

columns.name: DeletedBy
columns.description: User who deleted the content object. Field can be null.

columns.name: AIUtilization
columns.description: Indicates whether D2L Lumi (Brightspace AI) capabilities were used and the level of AI involvement. Possible values: 0 - No AI capabilities were involved. 1 - Generated by AI and reviewed by a human. 2 - Generated by AI and edited by a human. 3 - Assisted or uplifted by AI. 4 - Generated by AI but not yet reviewed by a human.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the row. This information is used to determine which table row occurred first, similar to the way timestamps function in other data sets.
